# Served synthetically at the CloudFront edge (JD-872); replaces the monolith
# robots_www.txt on the visitor/listing hosts. Content subdomains (blog,
# ugyfelszolgalat, karrier, sugo) are passthrough — they serve their own file.

User-agent: CariBot
Disallow: /

# AI/LLM TRAINING crawlers: banned from the ad pages (listing/adview/landing),
# allowed on the static content pages (decision 2026-07-03). Content
# subdomains are not affected — this file is not served there.
#
# What stays here is the training/corpus side. The ANSWER-TIME agents are
# deliberately absent (JD-1695): OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot,
# Perplexity-User, Claude-SearchBot and Claude-User cite the page and send a
# real visitor, which is the opposite of a training scrape. Naming no group for
# them is intentional — they fall through to `User-agent: *` below and get
# exactly Googlebot's rules, including every parameter and pagination
# restriction. Do NOT give them their own group: robots.txt groups do not
# inherit, so a separate block would silently open the whole filtered URL space.
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: Bytespider
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: Claude-Web

User-agent: meta-externalagent

Allow: /nyilatkozatok
